title: Nutty Shattering Korean Almonds Naengmyeon
description: A cold buckwheat noodle dish with crunchy fried almonds and a spicy, tangy broth that shatters with every bite.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the buckwheat noodles according to package instructions until al dente, then drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, add raw almonds, and stir-fry until golden brown and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes, then remove and set aside to cool.
Whisk together soy sauce, gochugaru, minced ginger, minced garlic, rice vinegar, agave syrup, and a splash of lemon juice to make the spicy sauce.
Pour vegetable broth into a saucepan, bring to a gentle simmer, and add the spicy sauce mixture, stirring until well combined.
Transfer the simmering broth into a serving bowl, add the drained noodles, and pour the broth over the noodles until they are fully submerged.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and fried almonds on top of the noodles, then garnish with julienned cucumber, carrot, and sliced scallions for freshness.
Optionally, add a few thin radish slices or a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and mint for extra aroma.
Chill the assembled naengmyeon in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
When ready to serve, give the bowl a quick stir to mix the flavors and enjoy the nutty, shattering crunch with a spicy, refreshing broth.
